rows.text: ぐっすり寝てるね
rows.english: Are you sleepy? Let's get cozy. Night-night!

rows.text: ぐっすり寝てるね

rows.text: お口がにこっとしたね

rows.english: Bath time is here! Is the water warm? Splash, splash!

rows.text: いっしょにお風呂に入ろうね
rows.english: Bath time, baby! Feel that water! I'll be gentle.

rows.text: 新しいお洋服に着替えようか

rows.text: 新しいお洋服に着替えようか
rows.english: Let's put clothes on. One arm first. Other arm next!

rows.text: お着替えは全部終わったかな
rows.english: All dressed now! Look at your outfit. Nice and cozy.

rows.text: お着替えは全部終わったかな
rows.english: Let's put clothes on. One arm first. Other arm next!
rows.note: 着替えが終わったかを尋ねるのに着替えを促す。

rows.text: おむつ替えはもうできたかな
rows.english: Diaper all done? Let's have a look. All clean now?

rows.text: おむつ替えはもうできたかな
rows.english: Time for a change. Let's get you dry. All fresh!

rows.text: あんよをばたばたさせてるね

rows.text: おなかがぐるぐる鳴ってるね
rows.english: Baby, my little star! I love you. Hello, sweetheart!
rows.note: お腹が鳴る観察を取りこぼす。

rows.text: おなかがぐるぐる鳴ってるね
rows.english: How's your tummy? Do you feel full? I'm here!

rows.text: いっぱいやったからおつかれさまだね
rows.english: You worked so hard. That's a lot. Rest if you like.

rows.text: 心配しなくてもそばにいるよ

rows.text: いったんお休みにしようね
rows.english: Are you sleepy? Let's get cozy. Night-night!
